caption: The drawing depicts a detailed rendering of a decorative ladle with three main views: a top view, a side view, and a small circular diagram showing the contour of the bowl from above, labeled "Contour of Bowl Top Elevation 1/2 Scale." The ladle features a broad, shell-like bowl with scalloped and radiating patterns, and an ornate handle with intricate floral and geometric motifs, including what appears to be a stylized face at the end. The handle is long and slightly curved, as shown in the side profile. The illustration is rendered in shades of grey and black, using fine lines and shading to indicate texture, pattern, and depth. The illustration is set against an off-white or light beige background, bordered by a simple, thin line. The artist's name, Francis Law Durand, is inscribed in small capital letters at the bottom right corner.
title: Silver Gravy Ladle
